title: Add MSRV matrix test (stable + MSRV) to CI
description:
Add a matrix strategy to the CI workflow that tests against: (1) stable Rust, (2) the MSRV declared in each crate's Cargo.toml rust-version field. Set MSRV to 1.80 as a starting point. Artifact: matrix in .github/workflows/ci.yml, rust-version fields in all three Cargo.toml files.

Acceptance: CI shows two parallel jobs (stable, msrv); MSRV job uses the exact version from rust-version; breaking MSRV is caught automatically
